sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。

related.title: 衛星太陽能陣列展開
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：教學能量裕度至少 0.10，原案通過、新載荷案失敗；所有模式還須通過容量與峰值檢查。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: For teaching margin at least 0.10 baseline passes and added load fails; all modes still need capacity and peak checks. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 用簡化彈簧能量帳比較摩擦增加對展開餘量的影響。
related.differenceEn: Compare deployment margin under increased friction using a simplified spring-energy ledger.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學週期可收集 90 Wh，平台、通訊及載荷合計需求 80 Wh。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：M=(90−80)/80。 結果約 0.125 fraction。能量裕度=(可收集能量−需求)/需求；必須對同一週期，另驗瞬間功率。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學 k=0.04 N m/rad、初始變形 θ=π/2 rad、摩擦轉矩 0.01 N m。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：E淨=0.5×0.04×(π/2)²−0.01×π/2。 結果約 0.0336401 J。彈簧可用能量 ½kθ²，固定摩擦耗能 τfθ；正餘能不保證每一角度都有正驅動轉矩。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. A teaching cycle harvests 90 Wh against 80 Wh total bus, communication and payload demand. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: M=(90−80)/80. Result ≈ 0.125 fraction. Energy margin=(harvest−demand)/demand must use one common cycle, with a separate peak-power check.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Teaching k=0.04 N m/rad, initial deflection θ=π/2 rad and friction torque 0.01 N m. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: Enet=0.5×0.04×(π/2)²−0.01×π/2. Result ≈ 0.0336401 J. Spring energy is ½kθ² and constant-friction work is τfθ; positive net energy does not guarantee positive drive torque at every angle.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
